cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: A deterministic Decimal-based tax rules engine verifies every training example against the Nigeria Tax Act 2025, so the fine-tuned model learns from engine-guaranteed calculations rather than LLM-guessed arithmetic.

test_prompts.prompt: I earn NGN 800,000 a year and no deductions or reliefs. How much tax do I pay? Please show the calculation.
What are the individual income-tax bands in Nigeria for the 2026 year of assessment?
